projectName: Control Plane Navigation and Settings IA Split
description: Uncrowd the current Settings junk-drawer by reorganizing Home Base into clearer control-plane areas before adding Tailscale publishing. Preserve recent UI polish, keep backend behavior stable, and create a dedicated Network home for Feature-4.

timing.gatingCondition: Should land before Tailscale publishing UI so Feature-4 does not re-concentrate operational controls into the current Settings page.

principles: Home Base is itself a control plane and should organize operational surfaces by function, not hide everything under Settings
Preserve recent UI cleanup and avoid re-mucking the app with another catch-all page
Prefer route and section extraction over backend redesign
Fix stale baseline tests before stacking more UI work
Give Network a dedicated landing zone before Tailscale publishing ships

techStack.runtime: existing static page routing via raw http.createServer
techStack.storage: No new data model required; reuse current config/admin/preflight/runtime endpoints
techStack.testing: node --test UI assertions, route tests, manual browser/mobile-nav verification

userStories.title: Operational controls are split into functional pages
acceptanceCriteria: Status page owns preflight checks, Home Base runtime/systemd status, and bootstrap/repair host entry points
Admin page owns execution lock, unlock/lock/rotate controls, and destructive-action audit
Config page owns hostname/domain, git transport, alert configuration, and Home Base self-update controls
Network page exists as a first-class route and placeholder home for Tailscale publishing work
Legacy /settings either redirects cleanly to /config or becomes an intentionally minimal handoff page
userStories.testStrategy: Route/UI source assertions plus manual browser pass across desktop and phone-width layouts

userStories.title: Navigation scales for a larger control-plane surface
acceptanceCriteria: Desktop nav includes Status, Admin, Config, and Network with clear labels
Mobile bottom nav keeps the primary four surfaces and moves overflow pages into a More sheet pattern
Active-page highlighting works for both direct items and More-sheet items
The nav change preserves current app/dashboard/jobs flows and recent visual polish
userStories.testStrategy: UI source assertions plus manual mobile-nav verification modeled on the Family Pulse overflow pattern

userStories.title: Baseline UI tests are green before Feature-4 begins
acceptanceCriteria: The three currently red baseline tests are updated or corrected so Home Base starts this slice green
Copy/selector assertions match the intended post-split UI labels rather than stale wording
No new failing baseline tests are introduced by the route split
userStories.testStrategy: Run `npm test` to green after the navigation/page split

medium: Route churn can create broken links or nav-state regressions if redirects are inconsistent
A too-ambitious redesign could sprawl past the intended pre-slice and delay Feature-4
low: Most work is extraction/reorganization of existing UI sections rather than new backend capability

preFlightChecklist: Choose exact /settings migration behavior: redirect to /config vs slim handoff page
Decide primary mobile nav four: Dashboard, Apps, Jobs, Status
Confirm Network page can initially ship as a thin scaffold before Tailscale functionality lands
Inventory any hard-coded /settings links so the split does not leave dead routes
